name: Joint and creep
author: Madhav Baliga
description: Bolted joints in plastic parts: a simplified VDI 2230 calculation (stiffness, preload from torque, embedding, thermal change), creep relaxation of the clamped plastic over the duty temperature profile, and slip and self-loosening per shot. Returns ranked risk flags with suggested fixes. An estimate for ranking designs, never a sign-off.

analyses.label: Joint, preload and creep
analyses.description: Add the joints (Analyze > Joints) and the duty profile (Analyze > Duty), then run. Uses the Thermal 3D temperature at each joint when that analysis has been run on this design, otherwise the duty temperatures.
